sections.title: Executive Summary
paragraphs: The aim of this document is to describe the Supplier User web service in terms of “what is it” and “how to use it”. It describes the webservice data-model, supported operation and related behavior and available interfaces.
Before going deeper with specific features of this webservice please ensure to review the document “J1P WS Development_Kit - Web Services Overview” which applies to all webservices
The structure of the current document is the following:
1. Upsert method

2. Request data format : describes the possible operations on import (CREATE, UPDATE and so on) and describes the structure of the request. The request is composed of sections and every section is composed of fields to be filled. This paragraph specifies which fields are mandatory depending on the operation you want to perform and those that can be omitted.
3. Behavior: describes how the web service processes the data passed in input, in case of some processes.
4. Response data format: describes the structure of the web service response and contains the list of possible error codes.
5. REST INTERFACE
6. Operation and Endpoints: describes REST available collections. Allowed calls with allowed parameters and supported HTTP methods
7. Request samples: contains detailed samples of HTTP request/response for each available operation

sections.title: Upsert (Insert/Update) Supplier User method
paragraphs: The Upsert Supplier User REST API allows to create/update supplier user all over JaggaerOne platform.
To create a supplier user, the API will perform:
A call to supplier IDM API to get IDM id (J1's unique identifier assigned to a supplier user in the supplier IDM).
A call to APIs of all J1P core apps that are active for specific tenant in Tenant Manager to create/update in each of them the supplier user.

sections.title: Supplier User creation in core apps
Conditions to create a user in JI, JCS and ASO
paragraphs: In case of JI is configured as primary system, if:
JI core app is properly configured and is enabled in Tenant Manager, supplier user will be created/updated on JI;
JCS core app is properly configured (JCS API url is mandatory) and is enabled in Tenant Manager, supplier user will be created or updated on JCS.
ASO core app is properly configured (ASO API url is mandatory) and is enabled in Tenant Manager, supplier user will be created or updated on ASO.

rows: ISO country code. If not supplied use company’s country
